concept.hr: cd u podljusci ne ostaje; čišćenje na izlazu s trap … EXIT
concept.en: A cd in a subshell doesn't stick; cleanup on EXIT

summary.hr: Skripta naredbu po naredbu: podljuska kao kopija okruženja, exit u zagradama, hvatanje EXIT koje briše privremeni direktorij.
summary.en: A script command by command: a subshell as a copy of the environment, exit in parentheses, an EXIT trap removing a temp directory.

title.en: A cd in a subshell doesn't stick

concept.hr: ( cd /etc ) mijenja samo kopiju; { cd /etc; } mijenja samu skriptu
concept.en: ( cd /etc ) changes only the copy; { cd /etc; } changes the script itself

title.hr: exit u zagradama završava samo podljusku
title.en: exit in parentheses ends only the subshell

concept.hr: Status stiže kao $?, a hvatanje glavne skripte izvrši se jednom, na kraju
concept.en: The status arrives as $?, and the main script's trap runs once, at the end

title.en: A variable lost in a pipeline

concept.hr: Petlja … | while read broji u kopiji, pa je brojač nakon petlje 0
concept.en: A … | while read loop counts in a copy, so the counter is 0 after the loop
